column1: # C oracle: the native CA type every record field is SERVED as by the
# Measured, not derived: one record of each base record type was loaded into
# and `cainfo` was run against every field the .dbd declares. 2558 fields
# resolved, 0 failures. Array records were instantiated with NELM=10
# SIZV=64 (lsi/lso/printf); `c_native` for a `cvt_dbaddr` field is the type
# under THAT instantiation, which is what `special` marks.
# This is the ground truth `dbd_generated_matches_c_oracle` pins the
# generated tables against: the .dbd declaration alone is NOT sufficient
# (DBF_ULONG is served as DBF_DOUBLE, DBF_MENU as DBF_ENUM, and an
# SPC_DBADDR field's type comes from the record's cvt_dbaddr, not the .dbd).
# VAL to DBF_USHORT — DBF_LONG on the wire, CA having no unsigned-16 type — when
# `!prec->sdef`, i.e. when the record defines no states at all. The bulk sweep's
# bare `record(mbbo,...)` defines none, so DBF_LONG is the row, measured the same
# way as every other. Both halves of the selector, on the same softIoc:
# The port implements both: VAL is `runtime_typed`, and the record answers
# `UShort` with no state table and `Enum` with one
